mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate margin expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above the prior 6-month average signals labor market tightening, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate margin expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline in quarters where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and a 2-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) together signal a synchronized demand expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 3-month YoY growth > prior 6-month average AND PAYEMS 3-month YoY growth > prior 6-month average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline in quarters where the joint trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).
